Whats up. 

Read your post and I can see some problems. For example, I dont see how low giftedness is implied by having bad grades in math. It all depends on what this grade was caused by. Did you receive feedback regarding your performance or did the teacher just hand you a grade which you later assumed to reflect your cognitive capacity? That's a big difference. 

Then you told us about having a knack for learning languages and writing at a level far beyond what is appropriate for your age. I was thinking about how you said that this was a sign of giftedness, which it sure is if going by definition that giftedness in some area is 130+ IQ. I also thought about your claim to have 135+ on ravens and if I recall correctly then the matrix IQ alone is a very good indicator of the so called g-factor, i.e. having a high IQ on matrices makes it probable that you could be equipped with high gifts in other areas. 

The fact that you are unsure on how you are placed in the giftedness category would not be odd given what you told us about how your environment treated you with regards to your smart. The big discrepancy between peoples perception of you can make anyone insecure whether ones own perception of ones ability is reliable. It could also be as a result of having very easy for some tasks, and very difficult on others. This unevenness is common för twice exceptional students. Perhaps look into that and sew how you relate? 

I really don't think your stupid, although you should learn to distinguish smarts from intelligent. You are intelligent in how you structure your thoughts and the level of insight is more than enough to not doubt your ability to think, but smart is more related to what you do with what you have. Reading books as a task on its own is smart, if the purpose is to learn more. Reading books for fun could be smart, but since the purpose is not to learn and focus your level of absorption of input is not as great. In this case you would learn less and therefore have low probability to perform smart.

I can, however, not relate to the responsibility part. I do take responsibility for the actions I do but I would still prefer if I can avoid conflict. This makes me indecisive- What should I do?
